description: Knox was spawned for plaud-ingest with a prompt that described the token problem as requiring interactive Chrome login. The plaud skill (skills/plaud-transcripts/SKILL.md or equivalent) handles token acquisition automatically. Master failed to instruct Knox to read the skill first, causing Knox to abort unnecessarily and report a false blocker to David.
correction: The plaud skill handles all token pieces — no user intervention needed if the skill is used properly. Knox should always read the skill before attempting any plaud operation.
fix: When spawning Knox for plaud-ingest, always include explicit instruction to read skills/plaud-transcripts/SKILL.md (and any plaud-related skill) before executing. Do not describe the token problem as a blocker in the spawn prompt — the skill resolves it.
